requirements.title: Provenance / authority
requirements.detail: PR branch rechecked at 40c424cf; full candidate tree, input surface and source/test hashes bound in delivery manifest.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Exact native artifact correlation remains Q43.

requirements.title: Pre-arm exposure
requirements.detail: Preserves upstream WAIT_UNFUNDED guard; no arm/modify before funding; positive progression, final live checks and trim obligations retained.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native BUY/SELL, actual RH trim, monotone floor under ADD/partial.

requirements.title: Durable async outcomes
requirements.detail: Scoped durable INTENT before send; pending/unknown/applied/partial/no-effect/settled lifecycle; terminal retained until durable consumer ACK; live order and immutable-ID checks; restart restoration.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native callback permutations, crash boundary and broker request/partial-fill behavior.

requirements.title: Replay and correction
requirements.detail: Exact receipt dedup, direction-first replay, bounded overlap, scan watermark, timestamp/deal merge sort, UPDATE/DELETE undo+apply, historic funding classification and atomic cash/receipt checkpoint.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native crash/late callbacks; missing or ambiguous historical phase goes to reconciliation.

requirements.title: Commission identity / validity
requirements.detail: History by POSITION_IDENTIFIER, missing history remains invalid, bounded retry restores readiness without a new topology event.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native ticket rollover and broker history availability.

requirements.title: Daily cash
requirements.detail: Shared booking-day reducer includes profit/swap/commission/fee, exact opening ownership, entry fees, correction and rollover; floating avoids double booking.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native Core/Recovery parity and broker fee attribution.

requirements.title: Daily denominator
requirements.detail: D-202 scoped denominator preserved; host external-deposit, restart and rollover cases.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: This is not exact midnight account balance; native scope parity pending.

requirements.title: PositionBook
requirements.detail: Immutable decision observation with ID index, role/direction/generation aggregates, stable order index, live cash refresh, revision/validity and explicit scope end.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: One whole-account capture per Recovery decision remains; native missed-event/final mutation freshness qualification.

requirements.title: Incremental campaign
requirements.detail: Sorted exact deal/owner cache; ordinary owned exit uses delta; corrections reduce cached records; history bootstrap only for initialization, campaign change, revision gap or recovery. OFF mode integrated.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native callback-order/history stress and behavior trace.

requirements.title: Streaming aggregates
requirements.detail: Sum/count uses scoped aggregates; saturation no longer builds/sorts Core book; ordered consumers retain time/ticket ordering.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native LIFO/oldest/threshold parity and scan counts.

requirements.title: Bounded persistence
requirements.detail: Atomic validated payloads, settled-prefix outcome compaction, receipt/epoch retention floors, RH tombstone retirement only after durable receipt proof, PY v1/v2 and flat OFF watermark loading.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native MQL POD layout, atomic replace/crash, active-state migration and rollback qualification.

requirements.title: Retry scheduler
requirements.detail: Persisted 1/2/4/8/16/30 second deadlines; 8 definitive rejects reconcile while retaining obligation. Unknown outcomes never become no-effect from timeout.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native server clock, restart and emergency exit liveness.

requirements.title: Local diagnostics
requirements.detail: Default-OFF handler/subsystem histograms and counters for pool calls, visits, selection, sort items, logical allocation requests, state bytes/I/O time, transport and reconciliation. No network or per-tick logging.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native wrapper compile and actual measurements; histograms return intervals, allocation bytes are logical requests.

requirements.title: Controlled benchmark
requirements.detail: Paired native-export validator checks five pairs, hashes, environment/set/data/profile/model/warmup/end date, trace equality and noise; reports medians/spreads and latency intervals.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: B1 is not natively qualified/frozen. No native benchmark, 50% scan gain or 5% latency claim; D-206 budget remains proposed.

requirements.title: ADX validity
requirements.detail: Inherited fail-closed policy retained; rejects invalid handle, absent buffer, NaN, infinity and EMPTY_VALUE.

requirements.title: Profit oracle
requirements.detail: Validation-only OrderCalcProfit cash oracle with explicit costs/reserve and bounded integer-tick bisection; BUY/SELL, bracket, monotonicity and failure guards.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Broker account-currency proof pending. Runtime SL/funding formula replacement remains conditional under D-205.

requirements.title: Phased composition
requirements.detail: State/cache/persistence concerns extracted behind existing compatibility interfaces. Full inheritance teardown is deliberately conditional on a qualified native trace.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native differential trace required before removing further wrappers; full teardown is not claimed.

requirements.title: Delivery / re-audit
requirements.detail: Full source, patch, docs, reproducible host runner and exact-tree package evidence. Same agent performed builder and verifier roles; no independent-human audit claim.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Native compile delegated to owner, independent audit and native acceptance remain open.
